requirements.criterion: Ordinary transfers/work conserve the goods, rights, payment and claims they move or reserve. Explicitly supported source/world/cheat creation, destruction, duplication or restoration executes its promised transformation with declared identity, scope and provenance; failed publication creates no unintended partial result.
requirements.proposedExpansion: Reuse current acquisition/gameplay/claim/custody owners for functional economy details and macro production. Native quotes and staged transfers must bind exact itemKey/count/holder/owner/revision, completion support and once/repeat policy. Rights or ownership do not automatically grant export permission. Conservation applies to ordinary transfer and incidental replay errors, not as a universal cosmological prohibition. An authorized transformation declares which owner domains are created/destroyed/copied/restored, resulting identity/provenance and any actual selected resource constraints; source-supported free/inexhaustible functions need no invented debit.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: stageAcquisition and gameplay_transactions stage actual transfer/consume/grant/native inventory. realm cargo binds real inventory/equipment/custody; current native Pocket passage rejects borrowed goods and passes no consent/permission grants. Pure permission planners exist, but this consumer is not a borrowed-cargo consent UI. Measured-material native validator illustrates provenance/custody uniqueness across inventories and reservations.
acceptanceCases: Reserved material cannot be sold/equipped/borrowed again
Lost support triggers selected refund/forfeit policy with no unpaid output
Two instance-local workshops do not share stock/claims accidentally
Loan export fails until exact supported permission exists; returning retained loans conserves holder/owner
Explicit creation or duplication succeeds with distinct supported provenance; no generic stock invariant rejects the promised new output
Restore/duplicate across a reset follows selected external-export, item-identity and claim scope rather than generic once-only suppression
Repeated command/cause delivery is rejected only outside the mechanism's explicit repetition/duplication allowance
requirements.remaining: Full inspected native buy/sell pricing/dynamic regional supply consumers remain needed for selected market requirements. No new economy ledger per content family. G4-10 and G4-11 define selected temporal/crossing transformation scope; finalized G2 duplication/creation card join remains pending.

migrationDecisions.decision: New initialization and instance metadata are optional and additive; existing completed origin or loaded life cannot receive a random second beginning.
Freeze accepted old jobs/receipts; new scoped bindings need versioned validators or explicit compatible mappings, with original envelope preserved on unsupported data.
Legacy unavailable-pack Village fallback is insufficient for a newly selected no-mandatory-Frontier opening; choose suspend/recovery/explicit alternate arrival without silently rerolling.
A stronger rollback or duplicate-instance feature declares included native domains, retained state and private-pack revision before migration or live write.

unreadRemainder: Final G1-G4/G6/G7 outputs and cross-lane conflict joins pending integrator request.
396 research artifacts inventoried, contents not exhaustively extracted; inventory is not source reading or reconciliation.
Native crafting/market/combat/lifecycle and world-specific bindings only sampled as stated; selected implementation must inspect exact consumers fully.
No sealed source truths, private pack content, novels, personal saves or newly acquired sources were inspected.
No arbitrary multi-era native initializer, complete duplicate-world isolation, universal future simulation or whole-world completion is claimed.
sourceSnapshotPolicy: Inputs hashes capture a dirty moving tree after inspection. Concurrent absorption modifies main/save/build and related new sources. A runtime writer must compare hashes/re-read affected exports before using this plan; this is no immutable integrated snapshot.
